title: next up
def: WR, TE, RB who have not broken out: no season so far, this one included, at the bar L = RB/WR 12, TE 9 PPR points a game shrunk to a depth player's by 4 games (L is the 79th (RB, WR) and 81st (TE) percentile of seasons with a real role); anyone at or over L is left out. QB, OL and defense are not scaled. breakout: next season at or over L with 8+ games, for the first time; base 2026 through week 11; odds = logistic on shrunk PPR/G, ln opportunities, position, share + age curve, experience and draft (each passes leave-one-season-out 2011-2025, final t 3.25, 12/15 seasons; 18 more pre-registered signals, model forms and recalibrations tested, 0 passed). SHARE: WR/TE share of team targets, RB share of team carries + targets. tiers: that many share points more; Y/OPP = next-season yards per target (RB: per carry or target) from his rate shrunk for sample, age and last season, plus yards per opportunity per added share point where teammates leaving the lineup forced the change: WR +0.000 (measured -0.041, t -0.49); TE +0.000 (measured +0.029, t 0.25); RB -0.023 (measured -0.056, t -2.35); used when |t| >= 2. YDS/G = Y/OPP x share x the team's targets (RB: carries + targets) a game; tiers past the 99th percentile of observed jumps or the largest share on record are beyond the data

cols.t: signals pushing his odds up most
